## Safety Notes

- Credential behavior: No credentials are required. Demo API-key and session strings in examples are illustrative placeholders, not live secrets.
- Network access: No required network behavior is declared in the selected skill; generated HTML should keep remote assets and external scripts explicit and provenance-checked.
- File access: Reads and edits user-selected HTML, markdown, assets, and documentation files when explicitly invoked by the user.
- Live action risk: Generated HTML may expose data through embedded content or remote assets; keep sensitive data local, review asset provenance, and avoid committing private files.
- MCP, background services, and external binaries remain opt-in; do not auto-start them from this catalog row.
- Secrets, tokens, private keys, connection strings, cookies, OAuth grants, and account IDs must not be committed.
